description: This file defines a Kotlin class BannerAdapter for an Android application. It implements a RecyclerView.Adapter to display banner cards with images and titles. The adapter manages a list of BannerItem objects, supports diffing for efficient updates, and handles focus and UI animations for banner items.

classes.name: BannerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying banner cards in a RecyclerView, utilizing ListAdapter and DiffUtil for efficient updates.

classes.name: BannerVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for banner items, managing view binding and focus animations.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new BannerVH instance by inflating the item_banner_card layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the BannerVH for a specific position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Populates the view elements with BannerItem data, setting title, image, and focus animations.
